# Crete Creations LLC

> Joplin MO epoxy garage floor contractor — 100% solids epoxy, full flake, high-solids polyaspartic. Arturo Escalante. 24+ years. Garage floors, driveway overlays, metallic pours. (417) 483-7082.

Crete Creations LLC is an epoxy flooring, driveway overlay, and decorative concrete contractor based in Joplin, Missouri, owned and operated by Arturo Escalante (24+ years of experience). Service area covers a roughly 75-mile radius across the Missouri, Kansas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas Four-State region. Phone: (417) 483-7082.
